messages:
Maya Singh: quick design huddle 1: mock for a compact multi-invite flow. goal: fewer clicks, keyboard-first. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC.
Owen Park: looks tight. question: how do we surface per-preset SSO requirement? small badge? :thinking_face:
Leah Torres: badge + aria-label on focus: 'Billing Admin, SSO required'. ensure presets reachable by keyboard.
Devon Reed: agree. avoid modal for role edits 1: inline expand keeps tab order linear.
Priya Shah: copy tweak: use 'Assign role' instead of 'Invite as'. success toast should be verb-first: 'Invites sent 1 4 recipients'.
Maya Singh: accessibility snippet idea: radiogroup for single-role batches, checkbox group for multi-role. aria-live to announce changes.
ux-bot: suggested analytics: invite.compact.started, invite.compact.completed, role.preset.selected. schema link: https://redwood.co/events/INV-900
Owen Park: visual nit: focus ring low contrast in dark theme. increase thickness or change color.
Leah Torres: failure copy: 'Invite blocked by SSO policy' and show which recipient was blocked. include a 'Resend with SSO' quick action where allowed.
Devon Reed: implementation note: add per-recipient inline status so admins can fix quickly.
Maya Singh: i'll update figma with inline expand, SSO badge, left-rail 'Manage presets' shortcut. Leah & Priya, can you review a11y and copy?
Leah Torres: will run keyboard + NVDA pass Friday.
Priya Shah: i'll open a tiny PR for copy + aria attributes after that.
